sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在黑胶时代的夜店打碟的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍爱的传家宝去上班，你把打碟台变成了一个充满美丽50年历史艺术品的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, hush money, catch and kill deals, the threat of blackmail, an elaborate system has developed to silence women who level accusations against powerful men.
sentences.zh: 今天，封口费、买断并掩盖交易、勒索威胁，一套精心设计的系统已经发展起来，用来让那些指控权势男性的女性闭嘴。

sentences.en: It's Friday, March 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月9日，星期五。

sentences.en: Jim, say I'm a powerful man and I have an affair with a woman.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，假设我是个权势显赫的男人，我和一个女人有了外遇。

sentences.en: I think she might take this affair public and I really don't want that to happen.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她可能会把这段外遇公之于众，而我非常不想让这种事发生。

sentences.en: In fact, I am determined to avoid that happening.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我决心避免这种情况发生。

sentences.en: What are my options?
sentences.zh: 我有什么选择？

sentences.en: Well, it does depend to some extent how wealthy you are, how powerful you are and who your friends are.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这在某种程度上取决于你有多富有、权力有多大以及你的朋友是谁。

sentences.en: But let me get to that.
sentences.zh: 但容我细细道来。

sentences.en: Jim Rutenberg covers the media for The Times.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·鲁滕贝格为《纽约时报》报道媒体行业。

sentences.en: So your most common route, sadly, is a payoff, hush money, usually done in the form of a nondisclosure agreement.
sentences.zh: 所以你最常见的途径，遗憾的是，就是花钱消灾，给封口费，通常以保密协议的形式进行。

sentences.en: You don't talk about this, I will pay you a great sum of money.
sentences.zh: 你对此闭口不谈，我付给你一大笔钱。

sentences.en: What if the woman does not agree to this hush money, to this nondisclosure agreement?
sentences.zh: 如果这个女人不同意这笔封口费和这份保密协议呢？

sentences.en: Well, do you have a lot of disposable money?
sentences.zh: 好吧，你有很多闲钱吗？

sentences.en: Then maybe you'd hire a private investigator and they will dig up dirt on the accuser and then give you a file, a dirt file.
sentences.zh: 那也许你会雇一个私家侦探，他们会去挖掘原告的黑料，然后给你一份档案，一份黑料档案。

sentences.en: And maybe you'll present it to her and say, do you really want to go forward with making this public because I can make this really difficult for you?
sentences.zh: 也许你会把它摆在她面前说，你真的要继续把这事公开吗？因为我可以让你的日子非常难过。

sentences.en: So this is basically a blackmail effort.
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上就是一场勒索。

sentences.en: Yeah, you could call it that.
sentences.zh: 对，你可以这么叫它。

sentences.en: And what if that threat doesn't work?
sentences.zh: 如果这个威胁不管用呢？

sentences.en: So that's where it helps to have a friend like David Pecker, owner of the National Enquirer.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么拥有大卫·佩克这样《国家询问报》老板的朋友会很有用。

sentences.en: And what he'll do is he will have his reporters get her story, convince her to sell it to them in an agreement in which they own the rights to her story forevermore.
sentences.zh: 他会怎么做呢？他会让他的记者拿到她的故事，说服她在一份协议中把故事卖给他们，在这份协议中，他们永远拥有她故事的版权。

sentences.en: And then they will put it in a file and lock it away forever.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会把它放进档案里，永远锁起来。

sentences.en: So the story is being bought in such a way that it will never be run.
sentences.zh: 所以这个故事被买下来后就永远不会被发表。

sentences.en: But because of the nature of the deal that this woman might sign, it can never be discussed.
sentences.zh: 但由于这个女人可能签署的交易的性质，这一切永远不能被讨论。

sentences.en: The term in the industry, catch and kill.
sentences.zh: 行业内的术语，买断并掩盖（catch and kill）。

sentences.en: It'll explain the catch and the kill.
sentences.zh: 我来解释一下“买”和“杀”。

sentences.en: You catch the story by sending your reporters out to snag it and then you bury it.
sentences.zh: 你通过派记者去抢购这个故事来“买”下它，然后你把它埋葬。

sentences.en: You kill it.
sentences.zh: 你“杀”了它。

sentences.en: You kill it.
sentences.zh: 你把它扼杀。

sentences.en: But the woman you had an affair with has signed away all the story rights to your friend at the Enquirer.
sentences.zh: 但是和你发生外遇的那个女人已经把所有的故事版权都转让给了你在《询问报》的朋友。

sentences.en: And Jim, hearing you describe these practices, we've seen these tactics being used not just to try to hide alleged affairs,
sentences.zh: 吉姆，听你描述这些做法，我们看到这些策略不仅被用来试图掩盖所谓的外遇，

sentences.en: but also to cover up very serious claims of sexual assault, right?
sentences.zh: 还被用来掩盖非常严重的性侵指控，对吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The recent avalanche of sexual harassment allegations has cast a spotlight on non-disclosure agreements.
sentences.zh: 最近雪崩般涌现的性骚扰指控让保密协议备受关注。

sentences.en: These are the contracts employers use to keep such matters private.
sentences.zh: 这些是雇主用来确保此类事件保持私密状态的合同。

sentences.en: Five women who accused O'Reilly of harassment were given settlements totaling roughly $13 million on condition they would never talk.
sentences.zh: 五名指控奥赖利骚扰的女性获得了总计约1300万美元的和解金，条件是她们永远闭口不谈。

sentences.en: Finally, we return to the Harvey Weinstein story and new revelations about the great lengths he allegedly went to in order to quash stories, silence his accusers,
sentences.zh: 最后，我们回到哈维·韦恩斯坦的故事，以及关于他据称为了压制报道、让指控者闭嘴，

sentences.en: and intimidate journalists.
sentences.zh: 并恐吓记者而采取的极端的最新爆料。

sentences.en: Harvey Weinstein is someone who the Enquirer would sometimes keep stories hidden about in order to take care of Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 哈维·韦恩斯坦是那种《询问报》有时会为其隐瞒故事以关照他的人。

sentences.en: A former National Enquirer reporter says Cosby's lawyers squashed her story.
sentences.zh: 《国家询问报》的一名前记者称，科斯بي的律师压制了她的故事。

sentences.en: Cosby's lawyers talked the magazine into trading the story for an exclusive interview with Cosby.
sentences.zh: 科斯比的律师说服杂志用这个故事交换了对科斯比的独家采访。

sentences.en: The question I have, Fred, is how many other times has the Enquirer done this?
sentences.zh: 弗雷德，我的问题是，《询问报》还做过多少次这种事？

sentences.en: What if none of that works and this woman decides to tell her story?
sentences.zh: 如果这些都不管用，这个女人决定说出她的故事怎么办？

sentences.en: Well, then maybe you'll just slime them in the press.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那也许你会在媒体上抹黑她们。

sentences.en: With Camille Cosby already stepping forward in defense of her husband, now their daughter, Evan Cosby, is attacking her father's accusers, writing on her Facebook page.
sentences.zh: 随着卡米尔·科斯比挺身而出为丈夫辩护，现在他们的女儿埃文·科斯比也在她的Facebook主页上发帖攻击她父亲的指控者。

sentences.en: There will always be jealous, vengeful, and crazy people out there to break anyone down.
sentences.zh: 外面总会有嫉妒、记仇和疯狂的人来打垮任何人。

sentences.en: Look, anything's possible, all right?
sentences.zh: 听着，什么都有可能，好吗？

sentences.en: But it goes to credibility, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 但这关乎可信度，不是吗？

sentences.en: All right?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: If you look at this in totality, this was a hit job.
sentences.zh: 如果你全面来看，这是一次有预谋的抹黑行动。

sentences.en: The New York Post devoted its cover to smearing the actress I mentioned earlier.
sentences.zh: 《纽约邮报》用头版来抹黑我前面提到的那个女演员。

sentences.en: The media really played a role in serving as Harvey Weinstein's enforcer.
sentences.zh: 媒体确实扮演了充当哈维·韦恩斯坦打手的角色。

sentences.en: This is an attempt to undermine the credibility, the reputation, the name of the woman that you've had an affair with in order to make her account seem flimsy, less credible,
sentences.zh: 这是一种企图破坏你与之有染的女性的可信度、声誉、名誉，好让她的说辞显得苍白无力、不太可信，

sentences.en: not worth publishing.
sentences.zh: 不值得发表。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it certainly sends a message to other women you should think about it.
sentences.zh: 对，这肯定会向其他女性传递一个信号：你得三思而后行。

sentences.en: So, Jim, how does Donald Trump fit into all this?
sentences.zh: 那么，吉姆，唐纳德·特朗普是如何卷入这一切的？

sentences.en: Well, he's the great, shiny example right now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他现在就是那个最耀眼的典型例子。

sentences.en: There are two cases in particular that have come to light that show a mixture of the approaches.
sentences.zh: 特别是有两起案件浮出水面，展现了这些手法的组合。

sentences.en: A report that Donald Trump had a year-long affair with the Playmate of the Year who was allegedly paid $150,000 in hush money by the National Enquirer.
sentences.zh: 有报道称，唐纳德·特朗普与年度玩伴女郎有过一段长达一年的婚外情，据称她收到了《国家询问报》15万美元的封口费。

sentences.en: So, the first case involves Karen McDougal, a Playboy model, celebrated centerfold.
sentences.zh: 所以，第一起案件涉及凯伦·麦克杜格尔，一名花花公子模特、著名的折页女郎。

sentences.en: Here she is, the Playboy playmate who the Wall Street Journal claims Donald Trump had an affair with while he was married to Melania.
sentences.zh: 这就是她，这位花花公子玩儿伴，《华尔街日报》称唐纳德·她在梅拉尼娅结婚期间与她有染。

sentences.en: She meets Mr. Trump at a party at the Playboy mansion where The Apprentice is filming.
sentences.zh: 她在《学徒》拍摄地的花花公子大厦派对上遇到了特朗普先生。

sentences.en: You're going to meet, you have a personal friend of mine and a great guy.
sentences.zh: 你会见到的，你是我的一位私交好友，也是个极好的人。

sentences.en: Then you're going to go to a swimming pool where you will be surrounded by some of the most beautiful women in the world.
sentences.zh: 然后你要去一个游泳池，在那里你会被世界上一些最美丽的女性环绕。

sentences.en: That's going to be a great treat.
sentences.zh: 那将是一次极大的款待。

sentences.en: She's in her mid-30s.
sentences.zh: 她三十岁出头。

sentences.en: And as she writes about it herself, she was quite taken with him.
sentences.zh: 正如她自己所写的那样，她当时深深被他吸引。

sentences.en: She says she had a nine-month-long affair with the president beginning in 2006.
sentences.zh: 她说她与这位总统有过一段从2006年开始、长达九个月的婚外情。

sentences.en: Flash forward to the campaign.
sentences.zh: 镜头快进到竞选期间。

sentences.en: McDougal posted this picture of herself with Trump on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 麦克杜格尔在Twitter上发布了这张她和特朗普的合影。

sentences.en: The caption, throwback Thursday in honor of the Republican debate.
sentences.zh: 配文是：为致敬共和党辩论的周四复古怀旧。

sentences.en: And she considers telling her story.
sentences.zh: 她考虑说出自己的故事。

sentences.en: Even tries to sell it to the Enquirer.
sentences.zh: 甚至试图把它卖给《询问报》。

sentences.en: What the Enquirer proceeds to do is swoop in to buy the rights to her story.
sentences.zh: 《询问报》随后采取的行动是迅速介入并买下她故事的版权。

sentences.en: And they offer her, as added incentive, a fitness column in their magazines and some cover exposure.
sentences.zh: 作为附加奖励，他们向她提供了一份在他们杂志上的健身专栏以及一些封面曝光的机会。

sentences.en: So what does McDougal say to this offer?
sentences.zh: 那么麦克杜格尔对这个提议作何回应？

sentences.en: Well, she takes it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她接受了。
那是15万美元。

sentences.en: And she signs this deal, accepts the terms, and goes off quietly into the night.
sentences.zh: 她签下了这笔交易，接受了条款，然后悄悄退场。

sentences.en: So then what's the second case, the other one?
sentences.zh: 那么第二起案件是什么，另一个呢？

sentences.en: The other case involves a...
sentences.zh: 另一个案件涉及一个……

sentences.en: Her name is Stormy, and that is very fitting because she is at the center of a political firestorm.
sentences.zh: 她叫斯托米，这非常贴切，因为她正处于一场政治风暴的中心。

sentences.en: A porn star best known as Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 一个最以为人所知的艳星名叫斯托米·丹尼尔斯。

sentences.en: Her real name is Stephanie Clifford.
sentences.zh: 她的真名是斯蒂芬妮·克利福德。

sentences.en: And this is, I guess, a hybrid case for our test case purposes.
sentences.zh: 我想，对于我们的测试案例而言，这是一个混合案例。

sentences.en: Trump meets Stephanie Clifford at this celebrity golf tournament.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在这个名人高尔夫锦标赛上遇到了斯蒂芬妮·克利福德。

sentences.en: According to Ms. Clifford, right after they meet, they start having an affair.
sentences.zh: 据克利福德女士称，他们一见面就开始了婚外情。

sentences.en: Which supposedly happened in 2006, just four months after Melania gave birth to son Barron.
sentences.zh: 据推测发生在2006年，就在梅拉尼娅生下儿子巴伦四个月后。

sentences.en: As she tells the story, which he denies, he offers her potential slot on The Apprentice.
sentences.zh: 正如她所讲述的故事（他对此予以否认），他提供给她一个在《学徒》中的潜在名额。

sentences.en: He dangles the idea of giving her an apartment.
sentences.zh: 他用给她一套公寓的想法来诱惑她。

sentences.en: But basically, she loses intereSt.
sentences.zh: 但基本上，她失去了兴趣。

sentences.en: The thing fades away.
sentences.zh: 事情就这样淡出了。

sentences.en: You don't hear about it for years.
sentences.zh: 你好多年都没听到关于它的消息。

sentences.en: Fast forward to the campaign.
sentences.zh: 快进到竞选期间。

sentences.en: Stormy Daniels realizes she has something that might be of value.
sentences.zh: 斯托米·丹尼尔斯意识到她手头有可能是很有价值的东西。

sentences.en: She wants to sell her story about this alleged affair.
sentences.zh: 她想出售她关于这段所谓婚外情的故事。

sentences.en: Trump's campaign gets wind of it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的竞选团队风闻此事。

sentences.en: And this time, it's not the National Enquirer that swoops in to buy her story to silence her.
sentences.zh: 这一次，介入买下她的故事以让她闭嘴的不是《国家询问报》。

sentences.en: It's Mr. Trump's own lawyer, Michael Cohen.
sentences.zh: 而是特朗普先生自己的律师，迈克尔·科恩。

sentences.en: And what does he do, this lawyer, Michael Cohen?
sentences.zh: 这位律师迈克尔·科恩他是怎么做的？

sentences.en: Michael Cohen enters into negotiations with Ms. Clifford's lawyer.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科恩与克利福德女士的律师展开了谈判。

sentences.en: And they strike a deal in which she will stay silent about her story forever.
sentences.zh: 他们达成了一项协议，她将永远对自己的故事保持沉默。

sentences.en: She gives Donald Trump the rights to any text messages, photos, video, anything that relates to this affair.
sentences.zh: 她将任何与这场婚外情有关的短信、照片、视频以及所有相关权利都交给了唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And that's supposed to silence it forever.
sentences.zh: 而这本该让此事永远销声匿迹。

sentences.en: Oh, boy, oh, boy.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪，天哪。

sentences.en: Money, power, politics.
sentences.zh: 金钱、权力、政治。

sentences.en: Amid all the chaos on Capitol Hill, you may have missed, isn't it amazing that you could have missed,
sentences.zh: 在国会山的种种混乱中，你可能错过了——难道不觉得神奇吗，你竟然会错过——

sentences.en: the revelations about a porn star named Stormy Daniels, who allegedly, well, I can't even, I can't even get into this.
sentences.zh: 关于一个名叫斯托米·丹尼尔斯的艳星的爆料，她据称，好吧，我甚至都无法，我甚至无法深入谈论这个。

sentences.en: Ms. Clifford's story comes roaring back right at the turn of the year.
sentences.zh: 克利福德女士的故事刚到跨年之际就卷土重来。

sentences.en: Like, happy new year, Mr. Trump.
sentences.zh: 就像是，新年快乐，特朗普先生。

sentences.en: And what happens is that the Wall Street Journal breaks a story that Michael Cohen arranged to pay Ms. Clifford $130,000 through an LLC he sets up in Delaware.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的：《华尔街日报》爆料称，迈克尔·科恩通过他在特拉华州设立的一家有限责任公司，安排向克利福德女士支付了13万美元。

sentences.en: This nondescript office building in Delaware is the headquarters of a company reportedly used to hide an alleged $130,000 payment from Donald Trump's lawyer to the porn star Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 特拉华州这座不起眼的办公楼是一家公司的总部，据报道该公司被用来掩盖唐纳德·特朗普的律师向艳星斯托米·丹尼尔斯支付的13万美元款项。

sentences.en: Then the New York Times breaks a story saying Mr. Cohen now says he provided all of that money.
sentences.zh: 随后《纽约时报》爆料称，科恩先生现在表示，所有这些钱都是他自己出的。

sentences.en: It's from his own pocket.
sentences.zh: 这是他自掏腰包。

sentences.en: Cohen reportedly arranged the payment in October of 2016.
sentences.zh: 据报道，科恩在2016年10月安排了这笔付款。

sentences.en: He declined to say why he made the payment.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝透露他为什么要支付这笔钱。

sentences.en: Cohen says that he wasn't reimbursed by the Trump organization or the Trump campaign.
sentences.zh: 科恩表示，特朗普集团或特朗普竞选团队并没有向他报销。

sentences.en: Ms. Clifford volleys back.
sentences.zh: 克利福德女士予以回击。

sentences.en: Making that statement did probably invalidate an NDA that was keeping her silent.
sentences.zh: 发表该声明可能确实使让她保持沉默的保密协议失效了。

sentences.en: Saying, OK, Mr. Cohen, you are talking about this deal publicly.
sentences.zh: 等于在说，好吧，科恩先生，你正在公开谈论这笔交易。

sentences.en: I also think I'm being impugned here, so I no longer respect this deal.
sentences.zh: 我也认为我的名誉在这里受到了诋毁，所以我不再遵守这笔交易。

sentences.en: Mr. Cohen goes, we find out this week, goes and gets a temporary restraining order silencing her once again.
sentences.zh: 本周我们发现，科恩先生去申请了一项临时限制令，让她的再次闭嘴。

sentences.en: And warning that she faces penalties if she publicly discusses a relationship with the president.
sentences.zh: 并警告说，如果她公开讨论与总统的关系，她将面临惩罚。

sentences.en: But she comes back and files a formal lawsuit seeking to get out of her deal, and that's where we are right now.
sentences.zh: 但她卷土重来，提起了一项正式诉讼，试图摆脱她的交易，这就是我们目前的处境。

sentences.en: That is a very, very messy situation for something that's supposed to be silent.
sentences.zh: 对于一件本该保持沉默的事情来说，这是一个非常非常混乱的局面。

sentences.en: Extraordinarily messy and very, very, very public.
sentences.zh: 异常混乱，而且非常非常非常公开。

sentences.en: I know you either do or don't have a nondisclosure agreement, which, if you didn't have a nondisclosure agreement, do you have a nondisclosure agreement?
sentences.zh: 我知道你签没签保密协议，话说回来，如果你没有保密协议，你到底有没有保密协议？

sentences.en: Do I?
sentences.zh: 我有吗？

sentences.en: You can't say whether you have a nondisclosure agreement.
sentences.zh: 你不能说你有没有保密协议。

sentences.en: But if you didn't have a nondisclosure agreement, you most certainly could say, I don't have a nondisclosure agreement.
sentences.zh: 但如果你没有保密协议，你绝对可以说，我没有保密协议。

sentences.en: Yes?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: You're so smart, Jimmy.
sentences.zh: 你太聪明了，吉米。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, did Donald Trump know about this at the time, this offer?
sentences.zh: 那么，当时唐纳德·特朗普知道这件事吗，这个提议？

sentences.en: That's a key question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关键问题。

sentences.en: In a statement to NBC News, Cohen writing in part, neither the Trump organization nor the Trump campaign was a party to the transaction with Ms. Clifford.
sentences.zh: 在给美国全国广播公司新闻的一份声明中，科恩部分写道：特朗普集团或特朗普竞选团队都不是与克利福德女士进行交易的一方。

sentences.en: His lawyer, Mr. Cohen, will not say exactly.
sentences.zh: 他的律师科恩先生没有确切说明。

sentences.en: Michael Cohen is one of the most loyal people there is, or at least has been, to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科恩是对唐纳德·特朗普最忠诚的人之一，或者至少曾经是。

sentences.en: If you look at loyal in the Donald Trump dictionary, you will see Michael Cohen's face.
sentences.zh: 如果你在唐纳德·特朗普的字典里查阅“忠诚”，你就会看到迈克尔·科恩的脸。

sentences.en: The president's press secretary, Sarah Huckabee Sanders, will not say exactly.
sentences.zh: 总统的新闻秘书萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯没有确切说明。

sentences.en: Did the president and Michael Cohen talk about this payment at any time during the campaign or thereafter?
sentences.zh: 总统和迈克尔·科恩在竞选期间或之后的任何时候谈论过这笔付款吗？

sentences.en: Not that I'm aware of, and I'd refer you to Michael.
sentences.zh: 据我所知没有，我建议你去问迈克尔。

sentences.en: And that will become a key point in a lawsuit that Ms. Clifford now has brought, trying to get herself out of this deal.
sentences.zh: 这将成为克利福德女士现在提起的诉讼中的一个关键点，她正试图让自己摆脱这笔交易。

sentences.en: Is it possible that this money that Cohen was paying Clifford was for something else?
sentences.zh: 有没有可能科恩付给克利福德的这笔钱是用作别的用途的？

sentences.en: No one is trying to make that argument.
sentences.zh: 没有人试图提出那种论点。

sentences.en: Did the president approve of the payment that was made in October of 2016 by his longtime lawyer and advisor, Michael Cohen?
sentences.zh: 总统是否批准了其长期律师兼顾问迈克尔·科恩在2016年10月支付的那笔款项？

sentences.en: Look, the president has addressed these directly and made very well clear that none of these allegations are true.
sentences.zh: 听着，总统已经直接回应了这些问题，并且非常清楚地表明，所有这些指控都是不实的。

sentences.en: This case has already been won in arbitration.
sentences.zh: 这个案子在仲裁中已经赢了。

sentences.en: And anything beyond that, I would refer you to the president's outside counsel.
sentences.zh: 除此之外的任何事情，我都会建议你咨询总统的外部律师。

sentences.en: On the one hand, the White House is saying fake news.
sentences.zh: 一方面，白宫在说是假新闻。

sentences.en: There was no affair.
sentences.zh: 根本没有婚外情。

sentences.en: The president has denied the allegations against him.
sentences.zh: 总统已经否认了针对他的指控。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, they're saying...
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，他们又说……

sentences.en: And again, this case has already been won in arbitration.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这个案子在仲裁中已经赢了。

sentences.en: Anything beyond that, I would refer you to outside counsel.
sentences.zh: 除此之外的任何事情，我都会让你去问外部律师。

sentences.en: So the White House is acknowledging an agreement to keep her silent, but they are simultaneously somehow denying that there was ever an affair.
sentences.zh: 所以白宫一方面承认达成了一项让她保持沉默的协议，但与此同时，他们却又不知何故地否认曾有过任何婚外情。

sentences.en: It's as simple as that.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这么简单。

sentences.en: It doesn't feel like the efforts to silence these two women, Clifford and McDougal, worked.
sentences.zh: 感觉让这两个女人——克利福德和麦克杜格尔——闭嘴的努力并没有奏效。

sentences.en: Because here we are talking about them and talking about their allegations of an affair with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 因为我们现在正是在讨论她们，讨论她们关于与唐纳德·特朗普有染的指控。

sentences.en: So how is it that we know about both of these alleged affairs?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们是怎么知道这两起所谓的婚外情的呢？

sentences.en: I mean, to put it in crass sort of tactical terms, they weren't well done.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，用一种粗俗的战术术语来说，它们做得并不漂亮。

sentences.en: We wouldn't be talking about this if they were handled the way they're supposed to be handled.
sentences.zh: 如果它们像本该处理的那样去处理，我们就不会在这里谈论这件事了。

sentences.en: Because these happen all the time and we don't know about them or we learn about them only years later.
sentences.zh: 因为这种事经常发生，而我们要么根本不知道，要么在多年后才知道。

sentences.en: And what's the best example of how poorly done this was?
sentences.zh: 而这做得有多糟糕的最佳例子是什么？

sentences.en: Well, right now, the legal dispute involving Ms. Clifford and Mr. Cohen, Trump's lawyer, involves how badly done her contract was.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就在现在，涉及克利福德女士和特朗普的律师科恩先生的法律纠纷，正牵涉到她的合同写得有多烂。

sentences.en: Her lawyer is alleging that Michael Cohen made a fundamental mistake in drafting this agreement with her.
sentences.zh: 她的律师声称，迈克尔·科恩在起草这份与她的协议时犯了一个根本性的错误。

sentences.en: There are places for signatures for Ms. Clifford, Ms. Clifford's lawyer, Mr. Cohen, and Mr. Trump.
sentences.zh: 上面有克利福德女士、克利福德女士的律师、科恩先生以及特朗普先生的签名栏。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump does not sign the agreement.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生没有签署该协议。

sentences.en: So her lawyer is saying that that means the agreement is null and void.
sentences.zh: 所以她的律师说，这意味着该协议无效。

sentences.en: That's interesting because on the one hand, Trump never signing it feels kind of better for him, for Trump, now that he's president of the United States, right?
sentences.zh: 这就很有趣了，因为一方面，既然他现在已经是美国总统了，特朗普从头到尾都没签字，对他——对特朗普来说——感觉似乎更好一点，对吧？

sentences.en: Because it suggests that he never felt sufficient guilt to sign this thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这表明他从未感到足够内疚去签署这东西。

sentences.en: On the other hand, I guess it means that the agreement is incomplete and she can talk about it.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我猜这意味着协议是不完整的，她可以谈论此事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Deduction would tell you that that might have been his intent in not signing it.
sentences.zh: 推论会告诉你，他当初不签字可能就是这个意图。

sentences.en: But even lawyers who aren't sure of this legal argument still think it was dumb to leave this blank signature.
sentences.zh: 但即使是不太确定这个法律论点的律师，也依然认为留下这个空白签名很愚蠢。

sentences.en: Why even bring him into the deal then?
sentences.zh: 那为什么还要把他拉进这笔交易里呢？

sentences.en: From what you're saying, these efforts to get silenced were kind of botched.
sentences.zh: 照你这么说，这些试图让人封口的努力简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: But I wonder if we also know about this because the person at the heart of it was elected president and you have all these reporters reporting on it.
sentences.zh: 但我想知道，我们之所以知道这件事，是不是也因为事件的核心人物当选了总统，而你们有这么多记者在进行报道。

sentences.en: Well, that's part of it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这也是一部分原因。

sentences.en: But there's another thing that they botched.
sentences.zh: 但他们搞砸的还有另一件事。

sentences.en: And that is that they were slow.
sentences.zh: 那就是他们的动作太慢了。

sentences.en: Mr. Cohen was slow to pay Ms. Clifford in the fall of 2016.
sentences.zh: 在2016年秋天，科恩先生迟迟没有向克利福德女士支付款项。

sentences.en: And so what she proceeds to do is engage in a new round of media talks.
sentences.zh: 所以她接下来做的事，就是开启了新一轮的媒体访谈。

sentences.en: There's a story in the Wall Street Journal just days before the election that mentioned Ms. Clifford's case.
sentences.zh: 就在大选前几天，《华尔街日报》上出现了一篇报道，提到了克利福德女士的案子。

sentences.en: And then it disappears for months.
sentences.zh: 然后它就消失了好几个月。

sentences.en: So basically nobody really remembers it or notices it.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上没有人真的记得或注意到它。

sentences.en: No one remembers it until the Harvey Weinstein story.
sentences.zh: 直到哈维·韦恩斯坦的报道出现，才有人记起这件事。

sentences.en: Women who say they were assaulted and harassed by President Donald Trump share their agony watching Harvey Weinstein being shunned by society.
sentences.zh: 那些自称遭到总统唐纳德·特朗普侵扰和骚扰的女性，分享了她们看着哈维·韦恩斯坦被社会抛弃时的痛苦。

sentences.en: Asking of the president, quote, why not him?
sentences.zh: 质问总统，原话是：“为什么不是他？”

sentences.en: And the Harvey Weinstein story, which brings this system, this systematic silencing of women, back to the fore, kind of shakes the trees again for President Trump.
sentences.zh: 而哈维·韦恩斯坦事件将这种体制、这种对女性的系统性封口重新带回了公众视野，再次给特朗普总统敲响了警钟。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: It's like he's Teflon.
sentences.zh: 他就像有特氟龙护体一样。

sentences.en: Things that would make other people lose their job or lose their credibility.
sentences.zh: 换作别人，这些事早就让他们丢了工作或失去了信誉。

sentences.en: And he just continues forward.
sentences.zh: 而他却一路畅通无阻地继续前行。

sentences.en: And it's, yeah, it's really upsetting.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，这真的让人很不舒服。

sentences.en: And suddenly everyone's talking about this infrastructure of suppressing women's stories and everyone's interest in these two cases is renewed.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，每个人都在谈论这种压制女性发声的体制，大家对这两起案件的兴趣也死灰复燃。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the Me Too moment had already raised the question of these NDAs, these nondisclosure agreements in general, which is a different systematic silencing of women,
sentences.zh: “我也是”运动（Me Too）已经引发了对保密协议（NDA）等一般性保密协议的质疑，这是对女性的另一种系统性封口方式，

sentences.en: which everyone agrees now I think is not acceptable in most of those cases.
sentences.zh: 我想现在大家一致认为，在大多数情况下这是不可接受的。

sentences.en: Jim, is there anything illegal or inherently wrong with what the president and those around him did in these two cases to try to keep these women from talking?
sentences.zh: 吉姆，在试图让这些女性闭嘴的这两起案件中，总统及其身边人的做法有什么违法或本质上不对的地方吗？

sentences.en: Well, I'd say in general it's inherently wrong if the woman has walked into a deal that she feels was unfair and that she was flim flammed and now she's silenced forever.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想总的来说，如果一个女人稀里糊涂地卷入了一场她觉得不公的交易，觉得自己被骗了，现在却要永远闭嘴，这本质上就是不对的。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: If she was tricked.
sentences.zh: 如果她被耍了。

sentences.en: If she was tricked.
sentences.zh: 如果她被耍了。

sentences.en: There could be a very important legal issue in how Stephanie Clifford was paid.
sentences.zh: 在向斯蒂芬妮·克利福德付款的方式上，可能存在一个非常重大的法律问题。

sentences.en: Was it possibly an illegal campaign contribution?
sentences.zh: 这是否可能是一笔非法的竞选捐款？

sentences.en: So that's a big deal.
sentences.zh: 所以这可是个大问题。

sentences.en: And that rises to a whole other level of story for us.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，这让该事件上升到了一个全新的报道高度。

sentences.en: How could a payment to Stephanie Clifford to keep her silent, how could that be a campaign contribution?
sentences.zh: 向斯蒂芬妮·克利福德支付封口费，怎么就能成为一笔竞选捐款呢？

sentences.en: Because if it was done with the sole intention of protecting Donald Trump, the candidate, from information that would damage him weeks out from an election,
sentences.zh: 因为如果这样做的唯一意图，是为了保护候选人唐纳德·特朗普，使其免受那些在距离大选仅剩几周、

sentences.en: if not days out from an election, then how is that not a political contribution?
sentences.zh: 甚至几天时会对他造成致命打击的信息的影响，那么这怎么能算不是一笔政治捐款呢？

sentences.en: Some are arguing, and there's certainly some way to that.
sentences.zh: 有些人正在这样辩论，而且这种观点确实有一定分量。

sentences.en: This will be debated and decided now in the coming months.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，这将成为辩论和裁决的焦点。

sentences.en: How many men, and I may be asking you to estimate here, but you've been reporting on this for a while, how many men do we think get this level of systematic protection?
sentences.zh: 有多少男性——我可能是在让你估算，但你对此已经报道了一段时间了——你认为有多少男性能够获得这种层级的系统性保护？

sentences.en: We know Weinstein, for example.
sentences.zh: 比如我们知道韦恩斯坦。

sentences.en: We know the president.
sentences.zh: 我们知道总统。

sentences.en: Well, we're learning about cases all the time, aren't we, ever since the Weinstein story broke of new instances of these cases.
sentences.zh: 嗯，自从韦恩斯坦事件爆发以来，我们一直在了解各种新案件，不是吗，不断有这类案件的新实例浮出水面。

sentences.en: However, again, the most common way they're dealt with is through sort of general NDAs and not these extra catch-and-kill elements.
sentences.zh: 然而，再次强调，处理这些事情最常见的方式还是通过一般的保密协议，而不是这些额外的“拦截并销毁”手段。

sentences.en: So what makes the Trump story so kind of sensational is those details.
sentences.zh: 所以，让特朗普的故事如此耸人听闻的，正是这些细节。

sentences.en: Think about it.
sentences.zh: 想想看。

sentences.en: Buying the silence of a porn star alleging an affair.
sentences.zh: 花钱买下一个声称与人有染的艳星的沉默。

sentences.en: Or in the case of Karen McDougal, having allies in the press from a tabloid whose job, whose main goal in life,
sentences.zh: 或者就卡伦·麦克杜格尔的案子而言，让一家小报里那些在媒体界有同盟关系的人介入，他们工作的职责、人生主要的目标、

sentences.en: its mission is to expose scandalous news about famous people grabbing the story and burying it on behalf of someone who's very powerful.
sentences.zh: 其使命就是去揭露名人的丑闻，结果却把故事抢过来，并代表某个权势滔天的人将其压下来。

sentences.en: That is just a whole other level of sensational.
sentences.zh: 这简直是把耸人听闻提升到了一个全新的高度。

sentences.en: Another way of asking this is how many people does the head of the National Enquirer personally protect?
sentences.zh: 换一种方式来问，就是《国家询问报》的负责人亲自保护了多少人？

sentences.en: How many friends of Pecker are out there, would you guess from your reporting?
sentences.zh: 根据你的采访报道，你猜外面有多少佩克的朋友？

sentences.en: Well, we know it's more than two.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们知道绝对不止两个。

sentences.en: I think it's a legitimate plural on the friends.
sentences.zh: 我认为用“朋友们”这个复数是完全合情合理的。

sentences.en: But because of the Me Too movement and because of reporting like what you have done, Jim, over the last year and a half,
sentences.zh: 但正因为“我也是”运动，正因为像你吉姆在过去一年半里所做的这些报道，

sentences.en: we now know about these efforts and this kind of system that's designed to keep these women silent in the case of Trump, in the case of Weinstein, even in the case of Bill Cosby.
sentences.zh: 我们现在才知道了这些努力，以及这种旨在让这些女性保持沉默的体制——无论是针对特朗普、韦恩斯坦，甚至是比尔·科斯比的案子。

sentences.en: So, do you think that this system is starting to unravel?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为这个体制开始瓦解了吗？

sentences.en: I think the system will never go away as long as there are powerful people with powerful connections willing to use their money this way.
sentences.zh: 我认为，只要还存在拥有强大权力和强大关系、并愿意这样使用资金的权贵，这个体制就永远不会消失。

sentences.en: But I do think that it's eroding.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为它正在受到侵蚀。

sentences.en: I do think that women will be way hipper to the idea that this could happen and they could find themselves in a deal that ultimately doesn't end up being in their best intereSt.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为，女性将会更加清醒地认识到这种可能性，并意识到自己可能会卷入一场最终并不符合她们最佳利益的交易。

sentences.en: I think the NDAs have taken on an appropriate stench that people are talking about.
sentences.zh: 我认为保密协议已经带上了一种人们都在议论的、不怎么光彩的味道。

sentences.en: Things are changing, but I don't see it going away anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 情况正在发生变化，但我没看到它在短期内会消失。

sentences.en: Thank you, Jim.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，吉姆。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报《交易书》（DealBook）的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，其中包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、吉尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的现场对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上对部分精选采访进行直播，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，你可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得一个月的免费权限来阅读我们所有的新闻报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Thursday night, in a surprise diplomatic gamble, President Trump accepted an invitation to meet with North Korea's dictator, Kim Jong-un.
sentences.zh: 周四晚上，特朗普总统在一次令人惊叹的外交豪赌中，接受了与朝鲜最高领导人金正恩会面的邀请。

sentences.en: I explained to President Trump that his leadership and his maximum pressure policy, together with international solidarity, brought us to this juncture.
sentences.zh: 我向特朗普总统解释说，他的领导力、他的极限施压政策，加上国际社会的团结，将我们带到了这一历史关头。

sentences.en: During an announcement in front of the White House, South Korea's national security advisor said that Trump would meet with Kim by May.
sentences.zh: 韩国国家安理会在白宫前发表声明称，特朗普将于5月前与金正恩会面。

sentences.en: It would be a historic encounter between two bitter adversaries.
sentences.zh: 这将是两个死敌之间具有历史意义的会晤。

sentences.en: There has never been a face-to-face meeting or even a phone call between the leaders of the United States and North Korea.
sentences.zh: 美国和朝鲜领导人之间从未举行过面对面的会晤，甚至连电话都没有打过。

sentences.en: The Republic of Korea, the United States,
sentences.zh: 大韩民国、美国

sentences.en: and our partners stand together in insisting that we not repeat the mistakes of the past and that the pressure will continue until North Korea matches its words with concrete actions.
sentences.zh: 以及我们的合作伙伴坚定地站在一起，坚持不重复过去的错误，并表示在朝鲜用具体行动兑现其言辞之前，施压将继续下去。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much, everybody.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: I'm honored to be here with our incredible steel and aluminum workers, and you are truly the backbone of America.
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸能与我们优秀的钢铁和铝业工人在一起，你们真的是美国的脊梁。

sentences.en: You know that.
sentences.zh: 你们自己也知道。

sentences.en: President Trump has followed through with his threat to impose steep tariffs on steel and aluminum, ignoring intense opposition from Republicans, business groups, and U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统兑现了对钢铁和铝征收高额关税的威胁，无视了来自共和党人、商业团体和美国贸易伙伴的强烈反对。

sentences.en: trading partners.
sentences.zh: 贸易伙伴。

sentences.en: Our factories were left to rot and to rust all over the place.
sentences.zh: 我们的工厂到处都在荒废、生锈。

sentences.en: Thriving communities turned into ghost towns.
sentences.zh: 曾经繁荣的社区变成了鬼城。

sentences.en: You guys know that, right?
sentences.zh: 伙计们，你们知道这一点的，对吧？

sentences.en: Not any longer.
sentences.zh: 好景不长了……哦不，现在不会了。

sentences.en: The workers who poured their souls into building this great nation were betrayed.
sentences.zh: 那些倾注心血建设这个伟大国家的工人们遭到了背叛。

sentences.en: But that betrayal is now over.
sentences.zh: 但这种背叛现在已经结束了。

sentences.en: In response to fierce lobbying, the president agreed to exempt both Canada and Mexico from the tariffs and held out the possibility of excluding allies like Australia.
sentences.zh: 为了回应激烈的游说，总统同意免除加拿大和墨西哥的关税，并留出了将澳大利亚等盟友排除在外的可能性。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the Times reports that foreign leaders who would be impacted by the tariffs are still warning of a trade war with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，《时报》报道称，受关税影响的外国领导人仍在警告将与美国爆发贸易战。

sentences.en: The Daily is produced by Theo Balcom, Lindsay Garrison, Rachel Quester, Annie Brown, Andy Mills, Ike Srees-Kotharajah, Claire Tennesketter, Paige Cowett, and Michael Simon-Johnson,
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》（The Daily）由西奥·巴尔科姆、林赛·加里森、雷切尔·凯斯特、安妮·布朗、安迪·米尔斯、艾克·斯里-科塔拉加、克莱尔·特内斯凯特、佩奇·科维特和迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊制作，

sentences.en: with editing help from Larissa Anderson.
sentences.zh: 并得到了拉里萨·安德森的编辑帮助。

sentences.en: Lisa Tobin is our executive producer.
sentences.zh: 丽莎·托宾是我们的执行制片人。

sentences.en: Samantha Hennig is our editorial director.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎·亨尼格是我们的总编辑。

sentences.en: Our technical manager is Brad Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我们的技术经理是布拉德·费舍尔。

sentences.en: And our sound engineer is Peter Sale.
sentences.zh: 我们的音响工程师是彼得·塞尔。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansverk of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯韦克创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Sam Dolnick and Michaela Bouchard.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢萨姆·多尔尼克和米凯拉·布夏尔。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael again.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: Daily listeners are always asking us about the story behind our theme music.
sentences.zh: 每日听众总是向我们询问主题音乐背后的故事。

sentences.en: So we teamed up with the podcast Song Exploder to make a special episode of Song Exploder about the daily theme music.
sentences.zh: 所以我们与播客节目《歌曲解密》（Song Exploder）合作，制作了一集关于《每日新闻》主题音乐的特别节目。

sentences.en: You can listen to the episode and read all about the way we approach sound at nytimes.com slash daily song.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 nytimes.com/dailysong 上收听这期节目，并深入了解我们处理声音的方法。

sentences.en: That's nytimes.com slash daily song.
sentences.zh: 也就是 nytimes.com/dailysong。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《电线刀具秀》（The Wirecutter Show）将为您带来如何筹办节日聚会的准备指南。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人在家般温馨的诀窍。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种一沾枕头就人事不省的深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们睡前会喝断片。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是习惯喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何地方收听 The Wirecutter Show。
